description: Pre-signing verdict for one EVM contract call: builds the calldata, re-encodes it with the full ABI and exact signature, builds an unsigned tx (placeholder nonce and gas; the wallet sets the real ones), approves the calldata against the ABI (blocktools evmApproveCall: ok, unknown_selector or bad_calldata) and checks the unsigned tx with blocktools verifyTx. verifyTx refuses by default an approval of 2^128 or more, unasserted inner calls (multicall, Safe) and delegatecall; optional expect_spender, expect_amount, expect_unlimited, expect_recipient, expect_value, allow_inner_call and allow_delegatecall state what the user intends (failures such as spender_not_expected, amount_not_expected, recipient_not_expected, value_not_expected). Returns verdict pass or fail with reasons, the data, target and value, verifyTx's CHECK THESE text and its approvals, transfers and inner_calls. Show the verdict before the user signs; do not send on fail. SwapChan never signs, sends or broadcasts. Powered by blocktools (ABI coding). How to combine this with the other tools: swapchan_playbook (workflows: find-money, best-swap, rebalance, revoke-approvals, bridge-stuck, token-safety, recover-old-wallet).

abi.description: Optional ABI JSON to use instead of the Sourcify / Etherscan lookup (labelled as pasted; not checked against source).

allow_delegatecall.description: Targets a Safe delegatecall may reach; else delegatecall

allow_inner_call.description: Inner calls allowed inside multicall / Safe, as "TO:SELECTOR"; else inner_calls_not_asserted

args.description: Arguments in order; arrays/tuples as JSON lists, big numbers as decimal strings.

chainId.description: EVM chain id or name (1 eth, 8453 base, 42161 arbitrum, 10 optimism, 137 polygon, 56 bnb, 43114 avalanche, 59144 linea, 534352 scroll).

expect_amount.description: Exact approval or transfer amount (base units); else amount_not_expected

expect_recipient.description: Recipient any token transfer must pay; else recipient_not_expected

expect_spender.description: Spender any approval must name; else spender_not_expected

expect_unlimited.description: Allow an unlimited approval to expect_spender (needs expect_spender; not with expect_amount)

expect_value.description: Exact native value in wei; else value_not_expected

function.description: Function name, or the full signature for overloads, e.g. "balanceOf" or "get(uint256)"

name: contract_approve_call
title: Pre-signing check of a contract call (unsigned, nothing sent)
